content: Arie Theophilus: Sabu sigaraba sifourtobon bobo aifan wei sanayi God ifouren simamatar on sigayam.
Osi dura sigayam mamaba bobo anai bag imamatar tous matasi si’tai on a osi min on dura sikurereb, osi sabu on dura wei auri sidudur.
On mes Orot Gagamim, yau tou on atonio osi bobo engon tutufin anai bag simamatar on aimatit tiwag, yau ainonot on iyobin dura totorinai wat atgayam weinem.
Yau dura atonio agagayam aurim, onai om unsagob dura aifan engon tutufin sibibebeyem on dura bag.
John Bapataito’otin an Rat Ra aurin Dura Sikurereb
Judea an aiwab orot wabin Herod imama an werai, priest wabin Zechariah, on min Abijah priest an dam emon. On awan wabin min Elizabeth, on jever mat on eb priest an dam warar emon.
Osi rus God matanai on asi yawas totorinai wat simama a Bada an baifafaro dura a an eta aurin on sifonabo tiwag.
Osi nanatus ambin yabin Elizabeth on arin, ato on awan Zechariah rus on siorokwar sijenikwar isawar.
Ra tani Zechariah on priest an bobo tafaror goa amonai God nanai ibobo, on an bobo an wera inat on ibobo.
Osi priest asi kik on nanaba sibigibubunuai, osi asi barom siyo on nan sirubinai sirifu kemai nan fifiu itterai mes. On mes on inai Bada an tafaror goa amonai irui,
ato sabu kuayo gagamin tafaror goa kounai on fifiu i’yaras an werai on sibabayoi.
Bada an anea on Zechariah aurin irobotet, sirifu kema an asumaiauai nan itawar, fifiu iyaras nan.
Zechariah iyeit anea it mom on iror ato iber.
Baise anea on aurin iyau, “Zechariah om men unaber mes! God on om am bayoi itatam, ato awam Elizabeth on arimon natum fifi orot inituai, om wabin unyorai John.
Om arimon men sunub uniyasisir, ato on fifi inrarat on sabu fani sigaraba mat arimon siniyasisir!
On God matanai on arimon orot gagamin bag. On sareu wawanis a sareu wine mat on men inatom mes. On inrarat mom on arimon Ayu Kakafotin inibonuai.
On arimon Israel sabu sigaraba maiau on inboes sinmatabir men asi Bada asi God aurin.

On arimon ainau Bada nanai inan, wawanin a faiwarin aubairuruotin Elijah ba. On arimon tatamas a nanatus inboes sinnat sinikaita men; on arimon sabu fonaseirotis inboes iniyames sinmatabir men asi bainonot on yawas totorinai sininonot: on arimon Bada an sabu inboes inbotitiwagis On aurin sinmousin.”
Zechariah on anea aurin iyau, “Yau arimon mamaba ansagob on dura ebikakafun on dura bag? Yau on orokwar wat, a awau on eb jenikwar wat.”
Anea iyafotai iyau, “Yau on Gabriel, yau on God nanai atatawar, yau on On iyafareu anat aurim anikakafun a atonio dura aurin on anawurem mes.

Baise om au dura aurin on men ututum, ato an werai bag weie bobo arimon inmatar. Om men ututum on mes om arimon awam inakok: om arimon dura men unikakafun inan on an rai yau aumatanim on innat inidura bag.”
Sabu on Zechariah simomousin ato sibinonotis on aibo mes wera weromin maiau nan tafaror goa amonai emama.
On tafaror goa emon igat mom, on men fofonin dura sabu auris itikakafun on, on asir imanai wat auris nan ibikakafun, on mes osi sisagob on Bada o anea on nan tafaror goa amonai aurin irobotet.
Tafaror kaitamom amonai Zechariah an bobo tafaror goa amonai ibobo on isawar ato on imatabir men inai au go.
Men weromin on awan Elizabeth on inafot ato roke nim nanaba on an goa amonai wat ima.
Elizabeth iyau, “Ari weie Bada on etaiai on ibaisiu. On atonio bobo iyamai imatar onai sabu matasi gibui men anbomamai mes.”
Iesu An Rat Ra aurin Dura Sikurereb
Elizabeth inafot an roke nimtereban kaita nanaba on nan God an anea Gabriel iyafarai inai Galilee amonai mafam gagamin tani wabin Nazareth on nan.
On dura ibo inat jeverei aurin, on jeverei min siyaumatanai orot wabin Joseph rus sittabin mes, Joseph min aiwab David an dam warar emon. Jeverei wabin min Mary.
Anea on aurin inat ato iyau, “Tuf aurim inama! Bada on om bisimui emama ato On an baimomogin on gagaminai bag imomoginem!”
Anea an dura ibikakafun on Mary iror, ato ibinonotai atonio dura an yabin on aifan.
Anea on aurin iyau, “Mary om men unaber mes; yabin God om ekakaberem.
Om arimon uninafot ato fifi orot unituai; ato wabin unyorai Iesu.
On arimon gagamin bag inmatar ato arimon sinyorai God Natun Aiyetunenei Bag. Bada God on arimon iniyamai iniAiwab, On wawan agirin David ba,
ato On arimon Jacob an dam warar auris iniAiwab au wantoan; an Baiaiwab on an kanfoun ambin!”
Mary on anea aurin iyau, “Yau on matafiu wat. Atonio bobo on arimon mamaba inmatar?”
Anea iyafotai iyau, “Ayu Kakafotin arimon amomui inar, ato God an faiwar on arimon om intaragabuem. On yabinai fifi Kakafotin min arimon sinyorai God Natun.
Enos om tuam Elizabeth. Sabu siyau on arimon men fifi inituai on, baise on toun on ari inafot an roke nimtereban kaita, basit on ijenikwar min on.
Bobo engon tutufin God aurin on fofonin wat.”
Mary iyau, “Yau on God an agirotiu, dura aifan ubikakafun on auriu inmatar.” Ato anea ikirir inai.
Mary Inai Elizabeth Ifasiuai
Men weromin gibunai Mary ibotitiwag ato yagiginai inai oyau oyau tafanamai Judea mafam gagamin tani amonai nan.
On inai Zechariah an goai ato Elizabeth ikakaiwai.
Elizabeth on Mary anbaikakaiu i’tatam on fifi yan amonai iyayob. Ayu Kakafotin Elizabeth ibonuai,
ato on fonan aumiet bag ikakafun iyau, “Om God an baimomogin on gagamin bag item jever engon tutufin amosi, a fifi unbibituai mat on God imomoginai!
Yau men anonosin atonio bobo gagamin bag auriu itmatar on, ato yau au Bada ayon on itnat yau itfasiueu mes?
Om am baikakaiu dura atatam mom on, fifi yau amonai on yasisirai iroboge.
Om On ututumai on yasisir gagamin bag, yabin Bada an aumatan om aurim ibikakafun on arimon innat inidura bag!”
Mary an Kwarer Ikwarer God Ifain
Mary iyau, “Yau nunuaui Bada abifain;
yau ayubiui on abiyasisir yabin God on yau au Baiyawasotin,
Yabin On yau inosiu, yau on an agir jever wat! Ra ari a ra gibui on sabu engon tutufin sinyoreu sinau God imomoginem.
yabin bobo gagamis bag on God Faiwarin auriu ifouren. On Wabin on Kakafotin;
God sabu ekakaberes osi iyabon On sebeberuai on, sabu ari ra semama auris a sabu ra gibui sinmama auris.
On iman faiwarin iyotet igat sabu ato osi iyabon taseseiris on engon ikugeyes sitagege.
On aiwab faiwaris asi mamageai simama emon on iyeires sisur, ato sabu kitumis on ibogaiis sigai.
On sabu kokoianis auris on asi sawar obis ibonues weines, ato sabu sawarotis on imas waganis wat iyafares sinai.
On an aumatan wawat agirit auris ibiyamai on ebokikin; ato On inat an agirotis Israel yangan inibaisis mes.
On an aumatan Abraham a On an dam warar engon auris ibiyamai on inos, on inkaberes au wantoan!”
Mary on nan Elizabeth bisinai ima roke ton isawar weie imatabir men inai an au go.
John Bapataito’otin Irat
Elizabeth an wera inat fifi itituai mes, ato fifi orot ituai.
On an sabu a an dam warar duran sitatam mamaba Bada ikakaberai on, osi mat engon on aurin on men sunub siyasisir on.
Fifi irat tafaror kaitamom nanaba isawar ato osi sinat fifi sitiaskibubuai mes, ato sigogoi taman Zechariah wabinai sitiwabseirai mes.
Baise fifi ayon iyau, “Ambin! On wabin on John tanyorai.”
Osi on Elizabeth aurin siyau, “Baise omi ami dam warar amonai on men iyafan tani atonio wab ibo on!”
Namon osi imasi wat fifi taman siyawur, an gogoi wab menan on fifi sityorai.
Zechariah on fef mes ifefeyan ato fifi wabin igayam iyau, “On wabin on John.” Osi engon tutufin nan on men sunub siduduran on!
Men weromin Zechariah awan iruseren dura ikakafun men, ato on ibosuruf God ifain.
Sabu engon tutufin on siber kwakwan, ato atonio osi bobo simamatar an dura on irat inai Judea oyau oyau tafanam engon ibonu.
Sabu engon tutufin on dura sitatam on sibinonotis ato sibitetem si’yau, “Atonio fifi inrarat gagamin on arimon mamaba inmatar?” Osi rerebai sit sisagob Bada iman an faiwar on fifi bisinai yen.
God An Dura Zechariah aurin Ibo I’gat on Ikakafun
John taman Zechariah on Ayu Kakafotin ibonuai ato God an dura ikakafun iyau:
“Ot engon tutufin Bada tanifain, Israel yangan asi God! On inat an sabu inibaisis a iniyawasis mes.
God on ati Baiyawasotin Faiwarin itet, an agirotin David an dam warar emon.
God ainau bag an aubairuruotis kakafotis awasi iyaumatanit.
On iyaumatanit arimon ati ragit sabu emon a osi sabu iyabon asi faiwar engonai sebiragitet on emon iniyawasit.
On iyau on arimon wawat agirit inkaberes a an dura bobaibasit kakafotin ibiyamai on innos.
On an aumatan tutufinai wawat agirit Abraham aurin iyamai ato ifaro iyau on arimon ati ragit sabu asi faiwar emon iniyawasit onai ot On tanbiagirai on men tanaber mes,
ot on kakafotit ati yawas totorinai wat On nanai tantawar ra au engon ati yawas tutufinai.
“Om Yau natu, on arimon sinyorem God Aiyetunenei Bag an aubairuruotim. Om arimon ainau Bada nanai unan an eta unbotitiwag wain.
Om On an sabu unibebeyes sinsagob God osi asi bokomas innotbur on arimon sinyawas.
Ot ati God on kaberotin a mamanauin. On arimon yawas on fomenei ra awan an kudidirin ba iniyamai inar ot aurit intagawai,
a safam emon ratafin intagawai osi sabu iyabon rabob an wouman didibar amonai semama auris, ot etai tanbibib on arimon tuf an etaiai inbonanawaiit tanabib.”
Fifi irat gagamin imatar a ayuai on eb irat an faiwar gagamin ibo. On efan koiteterinai nan ima ato an wera inat on wasai irobotet Israel sabu auris irerebai.
